items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section I, List of Answers on Terminology 14:1
items.html: Light that comes out of the category of Emanator and comes into the discernment of an emanated being is called the “expansion” of the light. In truth the upper light is not affected by this in any way, like one who lights a candle from a candle, where the first lacks nothing; rather, it is named so after the reception of the emanated being. (Part 1, Chapter 1, Inner Light, Item 1)
